deterministic_findings.title: Forward Secrecy Supported
deterministic_findings.plain_explanation: The negotiated cipher suite utilizes ephemeral key exchange (ECDHE/DHE), providing Perfect Forward Secrecy.
deterministic_findings.why_it_matters: Ephemeral key exchange ensures that recorded encrypted traffic cannot be decrypted retroactively even if server private keys are compromised at a later date.
deterministic_findings.evidence: Negotiated cipher suite TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 includes ephemeral key exchange.

evidence_items.description: Negotiated cipher suite TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 includes ephemeral key exchange.

deterministic_findings.recommendation: Continue enforcing ephemeral key exchanges (ECDHE) across all mail transport connections.
